svg.text: JAKIM/JSM HALAL STANDARDS — COMPLETE PROCESS-FLOW INFOGRAPHIC ATLAS
Authority → scope → requirement → HCP → evidence → assessment → corrective action → re-verification → authority gate → trust state
Usage of animal bone, skin and hair
Identification of pig skin and hair — Test method
The flow converts applicable standards into digital controls, HCPs, evidence, audit tests and traceable authority-gated outcomes.
Laboratory, AI and operational outputs are bound to the evidence, audit and authority workflow.
Events, provenance and state transitions are preserved across the AHTE trust graph.
